name: jwalk
scope: Walk large directory trees with regex, age, size, and type filters, emitting JSON Lines.
boundary: See command help for supported inputs and platform constraints.

name: envsub
scope: Render environment-backed templates with strict types, defaults, validation, and secret-aware diagnostics.
boundary: See command help for supported inputs and platform constraints.

name: hashsum
scope: Compute SHA-256 and BLAKE3 concurrently and create verifiable manifests for large file sets.
boundary: See command help for supported inputs and platform constraints.

name: meow
scope: Whimsical cat sound text transformer with translation, prefix, emphasis, and pitch controls.
boundary: See command help for supported inputs and platform constraints.

name: pwatch
scope: Passively sample Linux process state, RSS, and thread count.
boundary: Linux process sampling only.

name: ports
scope: Produce a Linux TCP/UDP listener map with best-effort process ownership.
boundary: Linux listener inventory; process ownership is best effort.

name: homestate
scope: Index a home or mapped directory, report changes and moves, and safely repair or restore problematic names.
boundary: See command help for supported inputs and platform constraints.

name: metascore
scope: Score file metadata and extended-attribute-name changes against a saved baseline.
boundary: See command help for supported inputs and platform constraints.

name: pll
scope: Lint XML property lists and flag malformed or risky launchd logic.
boundary: XML property lists only; not a launchd runtime validator.

name: bundleinfo
scope: Inventory `.app` and `.pkg` structure and metadata without executing bundle contents.
boundary: See command help for supported inputs and platform constraints.

name: clt
scope: Correlate hidden executables with identical content and optionally quarantine them.
boundary: See command help for supported inputs and platform constraints.

name: dtp
scope: Compare daemon executable trees with an HMAC-authenticated baseline.
boundary: See command help for supported inputs and platform constraints.

name: tjt
scope: Sample and report transient processes and deleted executable paths.
boundary: See command help for supported inputs and platform constraints.

name: cded
scope: Detect sensitive clipboard patterns and explicitly drain unauthorized content.
boundary: macOS clipboard inspection; draining requires explicit apply.

name: amtm
scope: Map AppleScript automation text into a static permission graph without execution.
boundary: Static AppleScript text analysis; no script execution.

name: aaas
scope: Audit and explicitly revoke macOS Accessibility TCC grants.
boundary: macOS TCC audit; revocation requires explicit apply.

name: webkit-tool
scope: Statically flag risky WebKit settings and native script bridges.
boundary: Static heuristics; no exploitability verdict.

name: portwhy
scope: Explain visible Linux listener ownership and report partial visibility.
boundary: Linux; reports partial process visibility.

name: accesswhy
scope: Report path mode and local identity evidence, with explicit access-control gaps.
boundary: Mode and local identity evidence; ACL and policy evaluation are incomplete.

name: patchwhy
scope: Capture a current binary/library identity for restart analysis.
boundary: Current fingerprint only; no process mapping or restart recommendation.

name: pcapwhy
scope: Turn offline PCAP/PCAPNG captures into bounded flow, VLAN, ICMP, and reset evidence.
boundary: Offline, bounded capture analysis; no live capture.

name: netwhy
scope: Collect DNS, default-route, and redacted proxy evidence for a destination.
boundary: DNS, route and proxy evidence; no reachability or firewall conclusion.

name: servicewhy
scope: Collect passive process-health evidence for a service PID.
boundary: Linux process evidence; no service dependency or restart analysis.

name: binarywhy
scope: Report executable metadata and a SHA-256 integrity observation.
boundary: Metadata and hash observation; no trust or malware verdict.

name: authwhy
scope: Report local account and group evidence, with explicit authentication-policy gaps.
boundary: Local account evidence; authentication policy is not evaluated.

name: certwhy
scope: Inspect a live TLS peer certificate, negotiated connection, and validation result.
boundary: Live TLS connection; failed verification stays failed.

name: expose
scope: Report local listener exposure, with explicit firewall/reachability gaps.
boundary: Linux listeners; firewall and remote reachability are not evaluated.

name: sandboxdiff
scope: Compare two JSON workload snapshots.
boundary: JSON comparison only; does not launch or observe a sandbox.

name: driftwhy
scope: Capture a current file-content fingerprint for later drift comparison.
boundary: Current fingerprint only; needs prior evidence to establish drift.

name: incidentsnap
scope: Capture a bounded read-only host and boot-context snapshot.
boundary: Host and boot context only; not a forensic acquisition.

name: unitwhy
scope: Explain systemd unit state, selected hardening controls, and bounded journal evidence.
boundary: Linux systemd and bounded journal evidence; no mutation.

name: restartwhy
scope: Find visible processes still mapping deleted files after updates.
boundary: Linux visible deleted mappings only; no automatic restart.

name: selinuxwhy
scope: Summarize SELinux enforcement state and bounded AVC denial evidence.
boundary: Linux enforcement and AVC evidence; no policy changes.

name: tfchanges
scope: Normalize Terraform/OpenTofu plan JSON into concise resource-change records and evidence-based risk facts.
boundary: See command help for supported inputs and platform constraints.

name: varmerge
scope: Merge environment, JSON, YAML, and defaults under a typed schema with value provenance.
boundary: See command help for supported inputs and platform constraints.

name: jsonprobe
scope: Run declarative TCP, HTTP, process, and filesystem readiness checks.
boundary: TCP, HTTP and file checks; process checks require Linux. No root-cause verdict.

name: jsondiff
scope: Compare structured desired and observed state with JSON Pointer paths and machine-readable changes.
boundary: See command help for supported inputs and platform constraints.

name: jsongate
scope: Convert JSON findings into consistent pass, deny, or approval-required decisions.
boundary: See command help for supported inputs and platform constraints.

name: spacelift-helper
scope: Normalize allowlisted Spacelift hook context.
boundary: Allowlisted environment context only; no hook execution or retention.

name: regocheck
scope: Detect a local OPA engine and report policy-evaluation readiness.
boundary: Detects OPA readiness only; does not evaluate policies.

name: binparse
scope: Read ELF, Mach-O, and PE structure safely using Go debug readers.
boundary: ELF, Mach-O and PE structure; does not execute input.

name: logic
scope: Read Logic Manual v1, roff man-page, and GNU Info source files.
boundary: See command help for supported inputs and platform constraints.

name: man2logic
scope: Convert roff man source into Logic Manual v1.
boundary: See command help for supported inputs and platform constraints.

name: info2logic
scope: Convert GNU Info source into Logic Manual v1.
boundary: See command help for supported inputs and platform constraints.

name: osx
scope: Inspect and manage macOS subsystems through structured commands.
boundary: macOS; state changes require --apply.

name: contextsnap
scope: Collect or normalize AWS and AliCloud caller identity with explicit profile and region.
boundary: Read-only STS identity; selected region is not proof of resource location. Saved inputs retain a supplied timestamp.

name: eventwhy
scope: Group bounded Docker event evidence by resource, action, and exit code.
boundary: Historical evidence only; limited Docker retention is reported as incomplete. No root-cause inference.
